core_obligations: Show every relatively parameter-free definable self-map of the simple-type locus is a successor iterate, using definable minima and a cofinite initial omega segment.
Prove uniqueness of the type of separated successor orbits, then of arbitrary finite tuples of separated orbits.

Embed the desired order successor-closed in the monster and show that an isolating formula for any additional p-element contradicts its own definable minimum, by moving that minimum one predecessor while preserving its type over the named tuple.

proof_roadmap.step: Establish initial/type-definable hull, discrete order, and definable minima.
Classify definable self-maps as successor shifts.
Derive unique completion of separated-orbit tuples.
Use omitting types and the predecessor contradiction to obtain exactly the prescribed locus.
